description: We're a creative team that loves building, experimenting, and learning together. With strong programming and research skills, we bring different perspectives to every part of our project. Everyone has their own strengths, and each person gets space to contribute and have fun. We communicate daily, stay organized, and aren't afraid to try something new or rethink an approach. Most importantly, we're here to challenge ourselves, enjoy the hackathon, and build something we're proud of.
